净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Light composite of value (book yield), quality trend (4-period ROE change), and revenue growth. Captures firms with improving profitability that remain cheap and growing. Cross-sectional rank normalizes.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

composite = (1/pb_lf) * (1 + clip((roe_ttm2/100 - lag4(roe_ttm2/100)), -0.9, 10)) * (1 + clip(qfa_yoygr/100, -0.9, 10))
依赖列: pb_lf, roe_ttm2, qfa_yoygr

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

composite = (1/pb_lf) * (1 + clip((roe_ttm2/100 - lag4(roe_ttm2/100)), -0.9, 10)) * (1 + clip(qfa_yoygr/100, -0.9, 10))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(1, pb_lf), add(1, clip(subtract(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), ts_delay(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), 4)), , 1)))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, pb_lf)
  3. 3. add —— 加法
    add(1, clip(subtract(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), ts_delay(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), 4)), , 1))
  4. 4. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(subtract(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), ts_delay(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), 4)), , 1)
  5. 5. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), ts_delay(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), 4))
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(roe_ttm2, 1)
  7. 7. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(divide(roe_ttm2, 1), 4)
  8. 8. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(roe_ttm2, 1)
使用字段：
列含义说明
pb_lfpb_lf（中间变量/衍生量）
roe_ttm2roe_ttm2（中间变量/衍生量）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 pb：pb_lf
  2. 计算 cheapness：1.0 / pb
  3. 计算 cheapness：cheapness.where(pb > 0, 空)
  4. 计算 roe：roe_ttm2 / 100.0
  5. 计算 roe_delta：roe - roe.shift(4)
  6. 计算 rev_growth：qfa_yoygr / 100.0
  7. 计算 roe_delta_clipped：roe_delta.clip(-0.9, 10)
  8. 计算 rev_growth_clipped：rev_growth.clip(-0.9, 10)
  9. 计算 composite：cheapness * (1 + roe_delta_clipped) * (1 + rev_growth_clipped)
  10. 计算 composite：composite
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_improving_quality_value(df): df_copy = df.copy() pb = df_copy["pb_lf"] cheapness = 1.0 / pb.replace(0, np.nan) cheapness = cheapness.where(pb > 0, np.nan) roe = df_copy["roe_ttm2"] / 100.0 roe_delta = roe - roe.shift(4) rev_growth = df_copy["qfa_yoygr"] / 100.0 roe_delta_clipped = roe_delta.clip(-0.9, 10) rev_growth_clipped = rev_growth.clip(-0.9, 10) composite = cheapness * (1 + roe_delta_clipped) * (1 + rev_growth_clipped) composite = composite.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) composite.name = "factor_improving_quality_value" "kw">class="kw">return composite
